title: cart/recommendation: decrease cache TTL from 300s to 5s in Redis cache
author: alex.dev@enigma-sandbox.io
diff:
diff --git a/src/recommendationservice/recommendation_server.py b/src/recommendationservice/recommendation_server.py
index 8f230a1..d921bc4 100644
--- a/src/recommendationservice/recommendation_server.py
+++ b/src/recommendationservice/recommendation_server.py
@@ -42,7 +42,7 @@ class RecommendationService(demo_pb2_grpc.RecommendationServiceServicer):
-    CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 300
+    CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 5
     
     def get_product_list(self, user_id):
         cached = redis_client.get(f'rec:{user_id}')
description: Lowered recommendation cache TTL to ensure users see newly stocked items within 5 seconds instead of 5 minutes.

title: cartservice: reduce redis max pool connections from 100 to 5 per pod

+++ b/src/cartservice/src/RedisCartStore.cs
@@ -31,3 +31,3 @@ public class RedisCartStore : ICartStore

title: productcatalogservice: unindexed SQL join on product recommendations table
author: db.lead@enigma-sandbox.io
diff:
diff --git a/src/productcatalogservice/db.go b/src/productcatalogservice/db.go
index aa11bb..cc22dd 100644
--- a/src/productcatalogservice/db.go
+++ b/src/productcatalogservice/db.go
@@ -75,4 +75,6 @@ func QueryProductsWithCategories(ctx context.Context) ([]Product, error) {
-    rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT id, name FROM products")
+    rows, err := db.QueryContext(ctx, "SELECT p.id, p.name, r.score FROM products p LEFT JOIN recommendations r ON p.category = r.category ORDER BY r.score DESC")
description: Introduced dynamic category join without composite index on (category, score), causing full table scans.
